customer_requirement_fixtures.need: evaluate whether Lilies turns cross-team customer requests into a trackable workflow
customer_requirement_fixtures.requirement: Receive a customer message, classify it as sales inquiry, delivery status, billing issue, or complaint escalation, then generate next handling step, suggested owner, missing information, and a customer-success-ready summary.
customer_requirement_fixtures.expected_outcome: routing result, owner suggestion, missing information, and customer-readable summary
customer_requirement_fixtures.acceptance_signal: covers sales, delivery, billing, and complaint inputs

customer_requirement_fixtures.need: turn client requirements into an acceptance-ready plan
customer_requirement_fixtures.requirement: Read a client requirement paragraph, extract business goal, roles, key data, risks, and open questions, then generate a workflow draft brief, acceptance case list, and pre-delivery checklist.
customer_requirement_fixtures.expected_outcome: structured plan, open questions, and acceptance checklist
customer_requirement_fixtures.acceptance_signal: includes goal, roles, risks, and at least three acceptance cases

customer_requirement_fixtures.need: run a stable exception handling process and understand failure ownership
customer_requirement_fixtures.requirement: Receive a failed order, support ticket, or system alert, judge severity and impact, request missing fields when needed, and generate handling steps, notification targets, trace, and postmortem note.
customer_requirement_fixtures.expected_outcome: severity, handling steps, notification targets, and postmortem note
customer_requirement_fixtures.acceptance_signal: covers missing information, actionable, and escalation cases

customer_requirement_fixtures.need: review generated automation before trusting it
customer_requirement_fixtures.requirement: Read a workflow description and check start inputs, core processing nodes, tool calls, error handling, acceptance cases, and release risks, then output publish decision, blockers, missing tests, and policy boundaries.
customer_requirement_fixtures.expected_outcome: publish decision, blockers, testing gaps, and policy boundary notes
customer_requirement_fixtures.acceptance_signal: rejects workflows missing acceptance cases or tool evidence
